DB.description: D1 database for GPROXY configuration, accounts, and usage. Cloudflare creates it during deployment.

GPROXY_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Choose an admin password of at least 8 characters. On startup, this changes a same-name user’s password, or enables and renames administrator 0 if no name matches. Sign in as admin at /console/.

GPROXY_MASTER_KEY.description: Credential encryption key: generate with `openssl rand -hex 32` and keep a backup. Reuse the same key when updating.
